subject: Game Theory
title: Vickrey Auctions
description: A short lesson to help you apply Vickrey Auctions.

hook.text: What if the highest bidder won but only paid the second-highest bid? That's a Vickrey auction.

buildup.text: Economist William Vickrey designed it in 1961 and won a Nobel Prize for the insight.

discovery.text: The magic: bidders should bid their true value. Overbidding risks overpaying; underbidding risks losing.

twist.text: Truthful bidding is a dominant strategy. No matter what others do, honesty is your best move.

climax.text: Google's ad auctions use a version of this: advertisers pay just enough to beat the next bidder.

punchline.text: The honest bid is the optimal bid.

quiz.question: What does the winner pay in a Vickrey auction?
